verdict.rationale: Qodo is a SaaS code-review platform with a CLI and MCP surface, so a versioned-API and deprecation-policy story fairly applies. The evidence pack shows no versioned API, no API version scheme, and no documented deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and the changelog and installation migration guide are adjacent material, not an API deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
